description: Get one institution's quarterly Call Report financials by CERT — balance sheet, income, returns, credit quality, and capital ratios — most recent quarter first, with its name, status, and holding company. Unsuffixed income and return metrics are single-quarter figures; _ytd metrics accumulate from January 1. Dollar amounts are in thousands. Quarterly data lands about seven weeks after quarter end; history reaches back to 1984.

from_date.description: Earliest quarter to include: a quarter-end date (2025-03-31), the same without dashes (20250331), or a quarter label (2025Q1).

metrics.description: Up to 25 metric names (fdic_list_reference topic metrics). Omit for the default health set: assets, deposits, uninsured deposits, equity, net income, ROA, ROE, net interest margin, efficiency, noncurrent-loan and charge-off rates, loans to deposits, and capital ratios.

items.description: Metric name from the catalog, e.g. roa, net_income_ytd, cet1_ratio.

quarters.description: Most recent quarters to return (1–200; 200 covers the whole history back to 1984). Within from_date/to_date it caps the count.

to_date.description: Latest quarter to include, in the same forms as from_date. Omit for the latest published quarter.

name: fdic_get_institution_financials

data_as_of.description: When FDIC last rebuilt the financials index (ISO timestamp).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `cert_not_found`: No institution record carries this CERT. `invalid_date_range`: from_date is after to_date. `pacer_shed`: This server's shared FDIC request queue is saturated and the call would wait past its budget. `upstream_rate_limited`: FDIC answered 429 and retries were exhausted. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

institution.description: Institution identity, status, holding company, and succession; fdic_search_institutions with certs returns the full record (charter class, regulator, county, dates, latest assets).

active.description: True while the charter is open and insured.

ended_on.description: Date the charter ended (YYYY-MM-DD); inactive institutions only.

holding_company.description: Top-tier holding company; absent when none is on record.

rssd.description: Federal Reserve RSSD ID of the holding company.

last_report_date.description: Quarter-end date of the latest Call Report on file (YYYY-MM-DD).

name.description: Current legal name, or the name at closing.

successor_cert.description: CERT of the institution that continued the franchise.

metric_definitions.description: Field, unit, and basis of each metric in rows.

items.description: Definition of one metric in the rows.

basis.description: point_in_time = balance at quarter end; quarter = that quarter alone; quarter_annualized = ratio from the quarter, annualized; year_to_date = accumulated since January 1; ytd_annualized = ratio from the year-to-date flow, annualized.

field.description: FDIC Call Report field code the metric maps to, e.g. ROAQ.

metric.description: Catalog metric name, the key it has in each row's values.

note.description: Caveat, such as zero meaning not reported.

notice.description: Guidance for an empty window, an inactive institution, or quarters left out by the cap.

quarters_available.description: Reported quarters in the requested window, before the quarters cap.

values.description: Metric name → value in that metric's unit (see metric_definitions); null when not reported.

truncated.description: True when more quarters were available than the quarters cap returned.

title: Get institution quarterly financials
